svg.title: bounded-symbolic-construct-validation.v1-calibration: registered trajectories (calibration)
svg.desc: Registered trajectory summaries for the bounded symbolic study. Lines are environment-cluster means. Whiskers are pointwise exact median intervals where finite. Algorithm replicas are averaged within each environment cluster; trajectories alone do not establish a registered contrast.
svg.text: Cluster means with pointwise exact median intervals where finite.
